title: Tech Note: Custom Password System with 4D Ajax Framework

historical_commentary.text: Authentication customization is a perennial need, but this specific implementation is tied to swapping out 4DAF's login plumbing, which no longer exists. Modern 4D applications handle custom authentication via ORDA/REST session tokens, and web-facing apps typically use standard web auth patterns (JWT, OAuth) rather than 4DAF-specific hooks.
related_updates: 4D Ajax Framework (4DAF) has been discontinued; modern custom-authentication approaches in 4D use REST/ORDA session management or JWT-based schemes
4D's built-in Password System has itself evolved substantially through later 4D versions
